verdict.rationale: Decagon's AOPs let teams define agent behavior/logic in natural language akin to human SOPs (decagon-docs-16, decagon-docs-36), and Browser Actions enable multi-step task completion across systems (decagon-docs-4, decagon-docs-27), implying capacity for multi-step workflows rather than single canned replies. However, there is no direct documentation or example showing the agent proactively asking clarifying questions or walking through iterative troubleshooting dialogue — missing for 10: explicit examples/transcripts of clarifying-question behavior, documentation of multi-turn troubleshooting logic, and independent/hands-on evidence of resolution quality in practice.
